description: countdown timer on top of screen to know exactly when that TNT is going to explode without need to see the TNT client-side

releases.notes:
Server plugin for Paper, Spigot, Bukkit and Purpur, Minecraft 1.8.8 to 26.3. Players don't need to install anything.

### Added
- Countdown above lit TNT, showing just the time (for example `3.4s`), coloured white, gold under 2s and red under 1s
- Primed sulfur cubes on Minecraft 26.2+
- Floating text labels on 1.19.4+, with `/tntimer toggle` to hide them per player; entity name tags on 1.8.8 - 1.19.3
- `/tntimer reload` and `config.yml`

**Minecraft 1.5.2** · Forge · Java 8

### Added
- 3D display mode: the timer floats above each TNT, like a nametag
- Redesigned settings screen with tooltips, sliders and per-mode sections
- HUD text scale option (replaces Small/Medium/Large)
- Up to 20 timers at once
- `K` keybind to open settings (Forge 1.5 has no mod-list config button)

### Changed
- First release for Minecraft 1.5.2, on the shared 3.0 code base
- HUD timers sorted by soonest explosion; 3D labels prefer the closest TNT
- Timer colours: white, orange under 2s, red under 1s
